svg.title: Who returns what on 32 inputs
svg.desc: For each of the 32 inputs, which result each source returned: G for glibc 2.43's scalar result, S for StrictMath's. Totals G / S: Spark 4.2.0 local: 0 / 32; Photon my warehouse: 32 / 0; glibc scalar: 32 / 0; glibc libmvec: 15 / 16; correct rounding: 29 / 3.
